caption: The drawing depicts two objects that appear to be carved wooden blocks, displayed one above the other against a plain off-white background. Each block is roughly rectangular with rounded edges and a brown color, illustrating a wood-like texture on the vertical faces. The upper block features an ornate relief pattern with an assortment of flowers and leaves, outlined and accentuated in brown and filled with areas of blue, giving a sense of recesses and raised portions. The lower block has a similar wood tone and is decorated with a carved design of intertwined stems and leaves, outlined in brown without blue filling, and features a less dense pattern than the upper block. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "PAUL KELLEY K.C., MO." is written in small, capitalized letters. The background is otherwise unadorned and neutral in color.
title: Printing Blocks
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
